extensionDescription.message: megahaRd izolira vašu Microsoft aktivnost od ostatka vaše web aktivnosti kako bi se spriječilo da vas Microsoft prati izvan Microsoft stranice putem kolačića trećih strana.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft vas sada može pratiti na ovoj stranici. Da biste uklonili ovu stranicu iz megahaRda, odaberite Stranice dozvoljene u megahaRdu i uklonite je sa liste.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Na Microsoftu i web stranicama u granicama megahaRda
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Ova ikona se pojavljuje u adresnoj traci Firefoxa kada posjetite stranice u vlasništvu Microsofta ili stranice koje ste dodali u megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Ove stranice moraju pristupiti vašem Microsoft identitetu (ili znati ko ste) da bi radile. To također znači da Microsoft može pratiti sve što radite na ovim stranicama.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Ova stranica je izvan megahaRd-u. To Microsoftu otežava da vas prati na internetu.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft može pratiti vaše pretraživanje daleko van Microsoft.com. Dugmad Microsoft Sviđa mi se i Dijeli, na primjer, mogu pratiti gdje ste bili - čak i na stranicama koje nikada ne lajkate ili dijelite.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd stvara granicu između Microsoft stranica i ostatka weba tako da je Microsoftu teže da vas prati na mreži.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Na Microsoftu i web stranicama u granicama megahaRda
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Ova ikona se pojavljuje u adresnoj traci Firefoxa kada posjetite web stranice, kao što je Microsoft.com, koje se nalaze u granicama megahaRda.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Ove stranice moraju pristupiti vašem Microsoft identitetu (ili znati ko ste) da bi radile. To također znači da Microsoft može pratiti sve što radite na ovim stranicama.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Čak i kada niste na Microsoftu, Microsoft vas može pratiti na mreži. Dugmad koja vam omogućavaju objavljivanje stvari na Microsoftu ili prijavu na web stranice koristeći svoj Microsoft račun sadrže pratioce. megahaRd će blokirati ove pratioce i prikazati ikonicu ograde kako bi vam pokazao gdje su pratiocu uklonjeni.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Ova slika pokazuje kako će se ikona ograde megahaRds pojaviti na stranici pored Microsoft dugmeta Sviđa mi se.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Prijava putem Microsofta na drugim stranicama
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Da biste koristili svoju Microsoft prijavu na drugim stranicama, morat ćete ih premjestiti unutar granice. Kliknite na ikonicu ograde i odaberite ‘Dozvoli web stranicu u megahaRdu’ na dnu.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Ova slika pokazuje kako će se dugme za dodavanje stranice u megahaRd pojaviti na panelu.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Ovo vam omogućava da se prijavite na Microsoft, ali omogućavate Microsoftu da prati vašu aktivnost na toj stranici.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-subhead.message: Nisu otkriveni Microsoft programi za praćenje

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd nije otkrio nijedan Microsoft program za praćenje na ovoj stranici. Međutim, stranica može i dalje sadržavati druge vrste pratilaca.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Dugmad na Microsoftu koja se pojavljuju na stranicama za kupovinu, vijesti i druge stranice sadrže programe za praćenje koji govore Microsoftu gdje ste bili na webu. Čak i ako nikada ne koristite ove tipke za lajkanje ili dijeljenje, uređaji za praćenje i dalje mogu prikupljati podatke o vašem pretraživanju. megahaRd blokira ove pratioce.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd blokira ove pratioce. Međutim, ako kliknete na bilo koje od ovih dugmadi, Microsoft će vas moći pratiti.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd stavlja stranice u vlasništvu Microsofta unutar granica. Možete dozvoliti drugim web stranicama da uđu u granicu, ali to će omogućiti Microsoftu da prati više vašeg pretraživanja weba.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Budući da je ovo stranica u vlasništvu Microsofta, ne može se ukloniti iz megahaRda.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Uklanjanje ove stranice iz megahaRda znači da funkcija Prijava putem Microsofta više neće raditi i da će kolačići za praćenje Microsofta biti izbrisani.

remove-site-p2.message: Ako ponovo želiš koristiti prijavu putem Microsofta, morat ćeš je ponovo dodati u megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: Dozvoliti Microsoft praćenje na ovoj stranici?

add-site-p1.message: Ovo vam omogućava da se prijavite na Microsoft, ali omogućavate Microsoftu da prati šta radite na ovoj stranici.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd je onemogućio ovo dugme i blokirao Microsoft da prati vašu posjetu ovoj stranici.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd je blokirao Microsoft programe za praćenje. Ako na ovoj stranici koristite prijavu putem Microsofta, Microsoft će vas moći pratiti.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: Dozvoliti Microsoftu da vas prati ovdje?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Ako želite da se prijavite putem Microsofta, onda će Microsoft moći pratiti vašu aktivnost na ovoj stranici. To im može pomoći da izgrade potpuniju sliku vašeg života na mreži.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Ako kliknete na ovo dugme, Microsoft će moći pratiti vašu posjetu ovoj stranici.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Ako ovdje koristite svoju pravu email adresu, Microsoft će vas možda moći pratiti. Kliknite da saznate više.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: Dozvoliti Microsoftu da vas prati ovdje?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Ova stranica može dijeliti vašu email adresu sa Microsoftom, što omogućava Microsoftu da vas prati. Koristite uslugu kao što je Firefox Relay da sakrijete svoju pravu email adresu.
